description: AGSC-07-19: /skills/index.json is one JSON object in JCS form followed by one LF, with exactly the members bundle_version (the content version of AGSC-04-25), license (bundle.license_prose, or the Content Use Terms identifier where none is set), packs (one entry per pack in code-point order of name), spec_version and terms (the Content Use Terms identifier, or the prose licence where the Bundle adopts another). A pack entry has exactly description, lock, members (the slugs of the cluster's published members, code-point order), name and path (the route of the pack's SKILL.md). Derivation over the minimal fixture with alder (draft) and birch (retired) added to the cluster agent-patterns, built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 1767225600 and no git history, so the content version is 0.0.0+20260101T000000Z (AGSC-04-25 with no tag and no history). members is [handoff, supervisor]: a draft is not published, and a retired item leaves the skill packs (AGSC-00-05). In the first sub-case the Bundle adopts the Content Use Terms, so license and terms are both their identifier; in the second it adopts CC-BY-4.0 (configuration and root document), so both are CC-BY-4.0. The pack entry is compared without its lock, whose value is the subject of the next case. The members of index and pack_members are compared as sets, by name.
